settings.loss: The plain request on every patch: the mean of the block's code toward its strongest-mean code.

reading.note: Read on the replay contract at tick 600, on a 128-cell torus from noise, one pixel per fine cell plus the 64-cell coarse grid upsampled on the torus, 8-bit picture, with seed 2026102201: the picture a visitor's replay shows. The winner fraction counts every patch; strength is the mean of u·c/m, with u the direction of the target code over every patch; winners use the strict original reader. On the research evaluator's own draw at tick 600, the earlier poster, the winner fraction was 1.000 and the strength 2.33 m. The set is block-6448-pole-3x3. The block is selected when its response ranks in the top 32 of the dictionary.
